notes: MAMS comparison experiment: does NUTS converge on the funnel when given target_acceptance=0.99? ANSWER: NO. ta=0.99 reduces divergences (48->34) and bias (z: 2.34->1.63) but worsens ESS (24.5->16.4, single-seed) because the 10-30x smaller step sizes prevent mixing in the funnel body. The funnel is a geometry problem, not a step-size target problem.
workflow: EXPERIMENT: does NUTS converge on the funnel when given target_acceptance=0.99, the same conservatism that MAMS uses? Gate: FAIL rhat=1.2305, ESS=16.4, div=3, z=1.846. Mixing gets worse with more warmup at ta=0.99 (same pattern as ta=0.80). Conclusion: ta=0.99 reduces divergences and bias but kills mixing in the funnel body. NUTS at ta=0.99 does NOT pass the funnel gate. ESS comparison is single-seed; the geometry-not-acceptance-rate conclusion rests on divergences + R-hat + 10-30x step-size collapse. Run date: 2026-07-29.
